title: Happy path - Logged-in user books 2 seats for the dummy event 'Acme Test Concert 2026', sees a success toast, the booking appears in My Bookings as Confirmed, and the event's available seats decrease by 2
preconditions: Valid demo credentials from testD.config.json (ginni@gmail.com / Garima@1234567890)

The dummy event 'Acme Test Concert 2026' already exists in the Events listing (created via TC_EVT_DMY_001) with 100 available seats, price 49.99, venue 'Dummy Arena', city 'Dummyville', category 'Concert' and date 2027-06-15
User is authenticated (or will authenticate as part of this case)

No prior booking by the same user for 'Acme Test Concert 2026' so the seat-decrement assertion is unambiguous (this test case does NOT cover duplicate-booking rejection — see TC_BKG_DMY_002 for that path)

Note: framework currently exposes event-card and My-Bookings locators (firstEventCard, firstEventTitle, firstEventSeats, bookingCards, firstBookingStatus) but no bookNowButton / bookingForm / bookingSuccessToast / bookingFormSeatsInput / bookingFormConfirmButton — these placeholders must be added to src/tests/locators/test.locator.ts before automating this case

testSteps.action: Navigate to /login and sign in with the demo credentials
testSteps.testData: Email: ginni@gmail.com, Password: Garima@1234567890

testSteps.action: After sign-in, click the Events tab in the top nav to load the events listing
testSteps.testData: Locator: #nav-events

testSteps.action: Locate the dummy event card by its title and capture the available-seats count for later comparison
testSteps.testData: Title to find: 'Acme Test Concert 2026'; Locator: firstEventTitle (h3 inside the article). Capture seats text from firstEventSeats (e.g. '100 seats left') — store as initialSeats = 100

testSteps.action: On the dummy event card, click the 'Book Now' (or 'Book Event' / 'Reserve' / 'Register') action to open the booking form/modal
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookNowButton (button or link inside the event card with visible text matching /book\s*now|book\s*event|reserve|register/i)

testSteps.action: Verify the booking form/modal is visible and contains inputs for: number of seats, contact name, contact email, contact phone, payment card number, payment expiry, payment CVV, and a final 'Confirm' / 'Book' submit button
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookingForm (.modal:visible or [role='dialog']:visible)

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy seat count into the seats/tickets input
testSteps.testData: Seats: 2; Locator: bookingFormSeatsInput (input[type='number'][name*='seat' i] or #booking-seats)

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy booker name into the contact-name input
testSteps.testData: Name: 'Acme Test Booker'; Locator: bookingFormNameInput (input[name*='name' i])

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy booker email into the contact-email input
testSteps.testData: Email: 'booker.dummy@acme-test.com'; Locator: bookingFormEmailInput (input[type='email'])

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy booker phone into the contact-phone input
testSteps.testData: Phone: '+1-555-0100'; Locator: bookingFormPhoneInput (input[type='tel'])

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy test card number into the payment-card input
testSteps.testData: Card: '4111 1111 1111 1111' (standard Visa test card, NOT a real card); Locator: bookingFormCardInput (input[name*='card' i])

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy card expiry into the payment-expiry input
testSteps.testData: Expiry: '12/29'; Locator: bookingFormExpiryInput (input[name*='expir' i])

testSteps.action: Enter the dummy card CVV into the payment-cvv input
testSteps.testData: CVV: '123'; Locator: bookingFormCvvInput (input[name*='cvv' i])

testSteps.action: Click the 'Confirm' / 'Book' / 'Pay & Book' submit button inside the booking form
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookingFormConfirmButton (button[type='submit'] or button with text matching /confirm|book|pay\s*&?\s*book/i)

testSteps.action: Wait for and verify a success toast/notification appears (e.g. 'Booking confirmed!', 'Booked successfully!', 'Payment successful')
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookingSuccessToast (div/role='status' with text matching /booked|booking\s*confirmed|payment\s*successful/i). Expected visible text: 'Booking confirmed!'

testSteps.action: Verify the booking form/modal closes (or is dismissible) after the success toast
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookingForm should no longer be visible

testSteps.action: Navigate to the 'My Bookings' tab/page and wait for the bookings list to render
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookingsNavLink (#nav-bookings or a[href='/bookings']); expected heading 'My Bookings' (bookingsHeading)

testSteps.action: Verify a booking card for the dummy event appears at the top (or near the top) of the bookings list
testSteps.testData: Locator: bookingCards; the first card (firstBookingCard) should contain the event name 'Acme Test Concert 2026'

testSteps.action: Verify the new booking card shows a status badge of 'Confirmed' (exact wording may vary: 'CONFIRMED', 'confirmed')
testSteps.testData: Locator: firstBookingStatus (.status / .badge / .booking-status). Expected text matches /^confirmed$/i

testSteps.action: Verify the booking card shows 2 seats booked
testSteps.testData: Locator: firstBookingSeats. Expected visible text contains '2' and a 'seat' keyword — e.g. '2 seats' or 'Seats: 2'

testSteps.action: Verify the booking card shows the correct price for 2 seats at 49.99 — either the per-seat price '49.99' or the line/total '99.98'
testSteps.testData: Locator: firstBookingPrice. Acceptable displays: '$49.99' (per-seat) OR '$99.98' (2 × 49.99). Both are valid per the spec

testSteps.action: Navigate back to the Events listing and re-locate the dummy event card 'Acme Test Concert 2026'
testSteps.testData: Locator: firstEventTitle filtered by 'Acme Test Concert 2026'

testSteps.action: Verify the available-seats count on the event card has decreased by 2 relative to initialSeats (100 → 98)
testSteps.testData: Locator: firstEventSeats. Expected visible text reads '98 seats left' or shows 98 in a 'seats' context. If the card instead shows '2 seats booked', that is also an acceptable display

locatorsAlreadyPresent: bookingCards / firstBookingCard / firstBookingEventName / firstBookingSeats / firstBookingPrice / firstBookingStatus
locatorsToAdd: bookNowButton (button/link inside the event card matching /book\s*now|book\s*event|reserve|register/i)

expectedResult: The logged-in user successfully books 2 seats for the dummy event 'Acme Test Concert 2026'. A success toast (e.g. 'Booking confirmed!') appears and the booking form/modal closes. In 'My Bookings', a new booking card appears for 'Acme Test Concert 2026' with a 'Confirmed' status badge, 2 seats, and a price of either $49.99 (per-seat display) or $99.98 (2 × 49.99 line-total). Back on the Events listing, the dummy event card's available-seats count has decreased from 100 to 98 (or the card now reads '2 seats booked').
